divergence_justification: Accept: inputevents.linkorderid has no served mapping at MedicationAdministration.identifier.value or MedicationAdministration.supportingInformation.reference; the ICU ETL writes neither (mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:7-23,38-100), and resource identity is opaque and cannot be inverted. This explains all 25,892 differing_null_only rows: every keyed row is present and all 25,892 rows are identical on representable columns. The loss is ancillary to the clinical grain (stay_id,starttime), inclusion, grouping, carry-forward, timing, vaso_rate, and vaso_amount; all defensible mappings were tried.

reopen_history.reason: Downstream SQL-on-FHIR consumers join derived tables on getResourceKey() resource keys, which the port computes internally but drops at the outermost SELECT. The attempt adds the paired key column beside each MIMIC identifier column (subject_id->patient_key, hadm_id->encounter_key, stay_id->icu_encounter_key, specimen_id->specimen_key). Additive and shape-only: both comparison paths project manifest columns explicitly, so no compared value can change. The MIMIC integer columns are retained as the oracle join keys.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Judge accept: inputevents.linkorderid has no representable FHIR mapping at MedicationAdministration.identifier.value or supportingInformation.reference; the ICU ETL does not select or write it (mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:7-23,38-103), so typed NULL is faithful and the gap is ancillary to the clinical grain (stay_id,starttime), inclusion, grouping, carry-forward, and vaso outputs. All defensible effective[x] and TIMESTAMP_NTZ mappings were tried. The sole endtime conflict is fully replayed to the upstream America/New_York TIMESTAMPTZ DST-gap cast at mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:9,61-69, with zero residual and 1/25,892 affected, consistent with DST-gap rarity.

This port was carried forward byte-identical to re-measure it against the corrected data -- do not re-author it. Expect previously accepted divergences to have shrunk or gone; if an hour-wide shift still appears, treat it as a finding and establish why the correction did not reach that path rather than accepting it as an upstream artifact.
